messages:
Oncall-Bot: Pager: high error rate on /v1/generate (service: inference-runtime) — paging SRE-Jordan and oncall rotation.
Alex C.: on it, joining incident channel. can someone grab customer impact for status page?
SRE-Jordan: I'm in, looking at logs now. seeing 5xx spike starting ~16:02 UTC, error rate ~12% over baseline.
Mira S.: noted — which routes are affected? embeddings or gen?
SRE-Jordan: primarily streaming and normal text generation endpoints (text-gen, streaming). embeddings look fine so far.
Emily T.: internal note: a handful of large customers reported timeouts via support ticket, forwarding examples.
Alex C.: ok we need an initial status page blurb. Drafting below — please edit.
Alex C.: ```Initial update (investigating): We are investigating increased 5xx errors impacting text generation and streaming endpoints in multiple regions. Some requests may fail or see elevated latency. Our SRE team is actively investigating and mitigating. We will provide updates as we have more information.```
Mira S.: suggest adding "possible partial impact" language for customers relying on streaming. also add affected regions: US-East and EU-West.
Alex C.: updated draft: ```Initial update (investigating): We are investigating increased 5xx errors impacting text generation and streaming endpoints in US-East and EU-West. Some requests may fail or experience elevated latency, particularly streaming sessions. Our SRE team is actively investigating and implementing mitigations. Next update in 30 minutes or sooner.```
Ops-Comm: looks good. Can we prepare a short customer email for high-usage accounts?
Emily T.: yes — here's a short template: ```Hi — we are seeing elevated errors/latency impacting text generation and streaming in US-East and EU-West. Our engineering team is working on a fix; no action needed from you. We'll follow up with a resolution and timeline. Sorry for the disruption. — Redwo od Inference Ops```
SRE-Jordan: mitigation progress: rolled back a recent runtime kernel change on a subset of nodes at 16:20 UTC, error rate dropped to ~6% on that pool. still elevated overall.
Mira S.: can we add that to internal comms: "rolled back kernel change to a subset — monitoring for stability"
Alex C.: internal update snippet: ```Mitigation in progress: reverted recent kernel change on subset of serving fleet (16:20 UTC). Error rate partially reduced; continuing rollbacks and increased capacity scaling while we validate stability.```
Oncall-Bot: Incident channel created: #incident-inference-1752003456. All updates should live there.
Ops-Comm: request reviewers for public publish: @Mira S., @Emily T., @Alex C. Please ack or send edits. We want to publish initial status page entry and send customer notice to accounts flagged as impacted.
Mira S.: ack — minor edit: change "No action needed" to "No immediate action required"
Emily T.: ack with Mira's edit. Also add note in customer email about ETA for next update: "we'll update within 30 minutes"
Alex C.: final public copy: ```We are investigating increased 5xx errors impacting text generation and streaming endpoints in US-East and EU-West. Some requests may fail or experience elevated latency, particularly streaming sessions. Our SRE team has begun mitigations, including rolling back a recent kernel change and scaling capacity. No immediate action required from customers. We'll provide a follow-up update within 30 minutes or sooner.```
Ops-Comm: publishing initial status page now — staging preview link: https://status-preview.redwood.ai/incidents/1752003456 (please sanity-check)
Mira S.: preview looks good. Confirmed no sensitive details.
SRE-Jordan: continuing rollbacks and verifying health, will report back with metrics.
Alex C.: update for internal leadership MTG: impact level = P2 (service degradation, partial regions), estimated affected pct of requests ~8-12% peak.
Oncall-Bot: Alert: additional higher error rates detected at 16:42 UTC; automations triggered to add capacity in US-East autoscale group.
SRE-Jordan: autoscale added +20% capacity, error rate down to ~3.5% overall. Still seeing sporadic 5xx on a small subset of nodes.
Emily T.: drafting resolved copy but holding until we confirm stable for 30m. Draft resolved: ```Resolved: The issue affecting text generation and streaming endpoints in US-East and EU-West has been mitigated. The serving runtime rollback and autoscaling actions restored normal request success rates. If you continue to experience issues, please reach out to support.```
Mira S.: add timeframe to resolved: "Issue first observed at ~16:02 UTC; mitigated by 17:06 UTC after rollback and autoscaling."
Alex C.: publishing update now: added a periodic update at 16:50 UTC about rollback + autoscale and ETA for resolution.
Ops-Comm: audience: public status page + targeted emails to impacted accounts. Emily, please send the targeted email using the template and include support ticket links.
Emily T.: will send now to the impacted account list and attach support examples.
SRE-Jordan: monitoring for 30m window. will post final resolved notice if stable.
Alex C.: thanks everyone. quick checklist for post-incident: 1) post a resolved status page update 2) internal incident summary w/ RCA 3) schedule follow-up to review kernel change rollout process. I'll own 1 and 3. Jordan please lead RCA.
SRE-Jordan: acknowledged, will collect logs/metrics and start RCA doc.
Ops-Comm: final note: remember to tag incident as "rollback-triggered" and include the kernel commit id in the RCA.
Alex C.: copying final resolved publish here when done.
SRE-Jordan: 17:06 UTC — stable across fleets, error rate back to baseline. posting resolved notice now.
Alex C.: ```Resolved: The issue affecting text generation and streaming endpoints in US-East and EU-West has been mitigated as of 17:06 UTC. Root cause: a kernel optimization change in the inference runtime that increased CPU contention on a subset of nodes. Mitigation: rolled back the change and autoscaled serving capacity. Customers may have seen elevated errors or latency between ~16:02–17:06 UTC. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support at support@redwood.ai.```
Mira S.: publishing resolved message to status page. closing incident channel in 2 hours after wrap-up. :white_check_mark: 
Emily T.: sent targeted emails and updated support tickets.
Oncall-Bot: Incident closed (channel archived) at 19:10 UTC.
